tasks.short: Recruit, train, and evaluate staff and recommend actions.

steps.what: List primary and supplemental staff posts
Recruit and train people for those posts
Evaluate staff and recommend personnel actions for programs
Sign the personnel action for programs and services

outputs: filed copy of signed personnel action v1

tasks.design: A job lists open posts in {HCM}. It does not score a person. The administrator recruits, trains, evaluates staff, and recommends the personnel action. They sign that action, and a job files that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: A name on a list could be treated as a decision to hire or to act.
tasks.enabler_now: Open posts can be listed from the staff record.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a person should be hired, trained, or recommended for an action is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator makes the personnel decision and stays responsible for it.

ambition.what: Sign a personnel action the same week a post falls vacant.

tasks.altitude: The week goes to recruiting and evaluation, not to copying the post list.

reach.task: Act only on the signed personnel action
reach.learn: That a post list is not a decision

evidence.claim: Digest [S9] says scholarship, admission, and staff decisions must not rest on automation alone, so hiring, evaluation, and a child's place stay with the administrator.

Digest [S10] treats hiring, staff evaluation, admissions, and learning outcomes as high-risk, and digest [S11] places those duties from 2 December 2027, so this design produces no score of a child or a staff member.
Digest [S12] says rosters and staff data need works-council consent, so this design estimates a headcount and does not assign named people from behaviour.

assumptions: Configure the staff record before a new store.
No score of a candidate or an employee is produced.
unknowns: Who else must sign a hire.
research_questions: How often a post on the list is already filled.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the recruit step is the conversation itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the ratio table or the stored code list when it changes, and clear drafts the administrator rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every candidate is still met in person. The high end assumes only the list is no longer copied by hand. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with parents and staff about learning problems.

steps.what: Discuss students' behavioral or learning problems

outputs: filed copy of signed conference note v1

tasks.design: The conference stays with the administrator, parents, and staff. A job files the note in {DOCS} only after it is signed. The meeting is not recorded, and a child's learning is not scored.
tasks.previous_blocker: A written summary could stand in for a conversation that had not happened.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed note can be filed without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: What to say about a child's learning or behaviour has to be heard in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator holds the conference and decides what the note should say.
tasks.altitude: The conference stays. Only filing the signed note shrinks.

reach.task: Hear the outcome from the administrator
reach.learn: That the note is not a score

evidence.claim: Digest [S10] treats hiring, staff evaluation, admissions, and learning outcomes as high-risk, and digest [S11] places those duties from 2 December 2027, so this design produces no score of a child or a staff member.
Digest [S9] says scholarship, admission, and staff decisions must not rest on automation alone, so hiring, evaluation, and a child's place stay with the administrator.
Digest [S12] says rosters and staff data need works-council consent, so this design estimates a headcount and does not assign named people from behaviour.

assumptions: The job does not record the meeting.
Nothing is sent to a parent before the administrator signs.
unknowns: Which problems may be written down.
Who else should be in the room.
research_questions: How often a parent cannot attend.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining conference time is the meeting itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the ratio table or the stored code list when it changes, and clear drafts the administrator rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every conference still happens in person. The high end assumes only the signed note is no longer retyped. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach classes or courses and provide direct care.

steps.what: Sign the session and care note

outputs: filed copy of signed session note v1

tasks.design: Teaching classes and direct care to children stay in person. A job files the session note in {DOCS} only after the administrator signs it. No model teaches or watches a child.
tasks.previous_blocker: A plan on a screen could be mistaken for the class having been taught.
tasks.enabler_now: The signed note can be filed from the existing record.
tasks.still_hard: The class and the care only happen with the child present.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator teaches and gives the care.
tasks.altitude: Teaching and care stay. Filing the signed note is the only part that shrinks.

reach.task: See what was signed as taught
reach.learn: That the note is not the class

evidence.claim: The manager digest says curriculum, people, and marketing stay manual, with drafting help only.

Digest [S10] treats hiring, staff evaluation, admissions, and learning outcomes as high-risk, and digest [S11] places those duties from 2 December 2027, so this design produces no score of a child or a staff member.

assumptions: The job never teaches or supervises a child.
unknowns: Which sessions the administrator still teaches themselves.
research_questions: How often the session plan changes on the day.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining teaching time is the class itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the ratio table or the stored code list when it changes, and clear drafts the administrator rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every class is still taught by a person. The high end assumes only the session note is no longer rewritten. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine fund allocations and authorize purchases.

steps.what: Total posted funds for staff, supplies, materials, and equipment

outputs: filed copy of signed purchase list v1

tasks.design: A job totals posted funds in {ERP} for staff, supplies, materials, and equipment. The administrator determines the allocation and authorizes the purchases, signs that list, and a job sends only that version. The total is not the authorization.
tasks.previous_blocker: A worksheet total could be ordered before anyone had authorized it.
tasks.enabler_now: Posted amounts can be totalled without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: What the centre can afford, and what to buy, is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator authorizes the purchase and remains responsible for it.

ambition.what: Authorize a purchase the same week the allocation is signed.

tasks.altitude: The decision stays. Copying the posted amounts shrinks.

reach.learn: Which fund the total came from

evidence.claim: The manager digest says a report can be built from the records, and any commentary must be checked against those figures.

assumptions: Configure the ledger before a new store.
Nothing is ordered before the signature.
unknowns: Who else must sign above a set amount.
research_questions: How often a posted amount is still provisional.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the allocation step is the decision itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the ratio table or the stored code list when it changes, and clear drafts the administrator rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every allocation is still judged line by line. The high end assumes only the posted totals are no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The childcare administrator spends the week with children, parents, and staff. Tables and filing a signed note move to a job. No model hires, evaluates, or scores a child or a staff member.
reach: Parents hear about a child from the administrator, not from a generated note.
Teachers receive only the schedule or the action the administrator signed.
skills_to_grow: Tell a headcount from a decision to hire or to change a program.
Reject a draft sentence that cites a code or a figure with no source row.
role.ambitious_version: A signed purchase or funding pack can go out the same week, and the administrator still authorizes it.
